verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a buy-rate, interchange-plus pricing model with no revenue split. The platform controls what it bills merchants, and merchant Billing Profiles set the fees and rates sellers are charged, which covers the buy-rate and sell-rate parts of the story. The interchange-plus model implies interchange pass-through, but no evidence shows per-transaction interchange cost reporting for managing the spread. missing for 10: documented interchange-level cost reporting or visibility, published buy-rate figures, independent corroboration of margin management in practice.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread

citations.quote: We lead with a buy-rate, interchange-plus pricing model, and have no revenue split.
You totally control how much you bill your merchants. And with our buy-rate model, any optimization to pricing or interchange costs goes directly to your bottom line.
Every merchant is assigned a Billing Profile to determine the fees and rates that are billed to the merchant.
